name: Ogre Head On A Stick = Party
label: Quest
description: Ogre Head On A Stick = Party: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Just one last thing you must do, soldier.

I've taken the liberty of putting Gor'tesh's head on a pike. Now all you have to do is take this head to the top of Dreadmaul Rock and stick it into the ground. Once you do that, watch as those cowardly ogres run for their lives! After you've had your fun, come back to me and I'll reward you for all of your hard work.

clips.title: Progress
paras: So? Did you paint any pictures of the event?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Outstanding work, soldier! Simply amazing! Oh I'll get the medal of bravery for this, er, I mean you'll be rewarded handsomely for this!
